verdict: Leads are coming in, but cost per lead spiked sharply this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 124 leads at an average cost of $8.77 per lead — a workable baseline. However, in the most recent 7 days, ad spend rose 57% while leads grew only 9%, pushing cost per lead up 45% week-over-week. Nearly all of that spend ran through a single campaign, and the last three days show the efficiency gap widening further. At the same time, organic local actions through your Google Business Profile dropped 50% week-over-week, adding pressure that paid volume isn't currently offsetting. We're tightening spend controls on the over-weighted campaign this week and addressing the setup milestones that are needed to fully support paid performance going forward.

average cost per lead this period

watch_item.issue: One campaign consumed 93% of this period's total spend while lead volume barely moved, driving cost per lead to unsustainable levels in the back half of the week.
watch_item.fix: Spend is being rebalanced across campaigns this week, and creative is under review to restore efficiency before next report.
